description: Ten prioritized public EdgeBench tasks, one Claude Code trajectory per task, two concurrent task cells, two hours per trajectory, using GLM-5.2 with adaptive thinking.

protocol_override_reasons.agent: the campaign uses the native Claude Code harness used by the official GLM setting
protocol_override_reasons.backend: the local campaign uses Docker instead of the official Kubernetes backend
protocol_override_reasons.model: the campaign evaluates GLM-5.2 through the Z.AI Anthropic-compatible API
protocol_override_reasons.timeout: the campaign uses a two-hour task budget instead of the official twelve hours
protocol_override_reasons.attempts_per_task: the campaign runs one independent trajectory per task instead of three
protocol_override_reasons.cell_concurrency: the local controller runs at most two task cells concurrently
protocol_override_reasons.judge_concurrency: the local shared Judge serializes ephemeral Judge containers
